name: Quebrada de Humahuaca
description: Quebrada de Humahuaca is a narrow mountain valley in Argentina's Jujuy province, running about 155 km north to south along the Río Grande. People have traveled this corridor for 10,000 years, and it later carried an Inca road. Visitors can see stone-walled farming terraces still in use, fortified hillside towns called pucaras, and traces of 19th-century independence battles.
